headline_verified: Finite-loss certificate proves GEN_3 independently (q=4,5,6 local certificates; 263 records / 2339 traces; no open leaves): every strongly C4-free G with p<=6 has S<=3|G|. Consequently the capped K=3 2-connected irreducible domain for STAR-LEX_cap/CF is empty. Sharpness: T11 (p=6,eps=-4, cheap triple) and Petersen (p=5, forces |U|<=10). Triangle-free p=6 admits |U|<=2.

Cut-vertex: every branch of a positive fully induced-critical strongly C4-free graph has order >=K^2; with accepted ROOT(3)..ROOT(8), no such graph with p<=2K has a cut vertex for 3<=K<=8 (closes residual 1<=eps<=K-4 at K=5,6,7,8). At K=9 any capped cut-vertex example has order >=271 (finite ROOT(9)).

Side refinements T28.1–T28.8 (K-free rooted lemma, residual reductions, short-root gluing, even-K tree augmentation); ASSEMBLY: RB_K + capped 2-connected irreducible endpoint/model theorem => GEN_K (conditional).

Kill-tests COMPLETE: K=3 n=18 T=2: 154302 classes, 65 irreducible, 0 R*/CF failures; K=3 n=19 T=1: 947028 canonical, 40 irreducible, 0 R*/CF failures; K=4 Robertson/tree family n=21: 48 irr (0 fail), n=22: 564 irr / 588 records (0 fail). No irreducible R*/CF endpoint failure. H21 remains the unique (reducible) critical R* obstruction in the Petersen-block-tree class.
